title: WPSS/1592/2013 of Smt Geeta Rana AND ANOTHER Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No.1592 of 2013
Honíble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. Anirudh Bhatt, Advocate for the
petitioners.
Mr. Subhash Upadhyaya, Standing
Counsel for the State.
Heard learned counsel for the
parties.
Present petition has been filed by the
petitioner for calling the record of the
respondent department and quashing the
impugned transfer order dated 28.09.2013
passed by the respondent no.2 i.e.
Director, Department of Fisheries,
Uttarakhand, Dehradun. Further prayer
has been made for a direction to the
respondent department not to transfer the
petitioners from their present place of
posting in disregard of the transfer policy
formulated by the State Government.
Learned counsel for the petitioners
submitted that the petitioner no.1 has
been transferred from Directorate
Fisheries, Dehradun to Almora and the
petitioner no.2 has been transferred from
Dehradun to Nainital. He submitted that
the husband of the petitioner no.1 is
working in the District & Sessions Court,
Dehradun. He submitted that the
petitioner no.1 is suffering from heart
disease and has been advised not to live in
hilly terrain. He submitted that the
petitioner no.2 has two small school going
children and are studying in Dehradun
and their mother because of her posting in
Chakrata Block is staying there and in
case petitioner is compelled to join at new
transferred place, then in that event, the

studies of his children will be adversely
affected. He argued that the respondents
while passing the order impugned have
not considered these facts. He submitted
that though the petitioners have not
pleaded in the writ petition, but the fact is
that the then Director was going to retire
on 30.09.2013 and just two daysí before
his retirement, he passed the order
impugned. He also submitted that there
was no urgency in making transfer in the
mid session.
Considering the submission
advanced by the learned counsel for the
parties, the writ petition is disposed of by
permitting the petitioners to submit a
fresh representation before the competent
authority within a period of one week from
today. In case such representation is filed
by the petitioners within the stipulated
period, same shall be decided by the
competent authority, in accordance with
law, within a period of ten daysí from the
date of filing of representation along with
the certified copy of this order. Till the
representation filed by the petitioners is
decided, the order dated 28.09.2013 (so
far it relates to the petitioners), shall be
kept in abeyance.
Stay application also stands disposed
of.
Let a certified copy of this order be
supplied to the learned counsel for the
parties today itself on payment of usual
charges.
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
Arpan 09.10.2013
